findings.note: In a Nov. 13 odds update, Hutson moved past Cale Makar into third on the Norris Trophy board at +600. That points to a strong, healthy start to the season, which is mildly against an Under, but the page has no shot data.
ESPN's career stats page lists Hutson as active, with 3 goals, 7 assists and 10 points in 2026-27. The excerpt has no shots-on-goal or ice-time numbers, so it says nothing about the 1.5 line.

This older NHL.com piece describes Hutson as a pass-first defenseman who tied the rookie record for assists by a defenseman with 60. That fits a lower shot volume, but it does not cover this season or this game.
